basis: Calibrated from outer wall bounding box found via gray-color (140,140,140) pixel-region flood fill on 1f_view.png: outer wall faces at x=425/1817 px (0/15 m) and y=346/1088 px (8/0 m, top of image=North=y8, bottom=South=y0). Partition centerlines, window bands (cyan flood fill) and door leaf/gap extents measured the same way. Interior corridor-door opening widths approximated (~0.9m) from measured door-leaf pixel length; west and south exterior door widths taken directly from measured wall gaps (1.5m and 0.9m).
